mapper.select: SELECT CURRENCY AS "currency", RATE_DATE AS "rateDate", RATE AS "rate", SOURCE AS "source", FETCHED_AT AS "fetchedAt" FROM FX_RATE_CACHE WHERE CURRENCY = #{currency} AND RATE_DATE = #{rateDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FX_RATE_CACHE (CURRENCY, RATE_DATE, RATE, SOURCE, FETCHED_AT) VALUES (#{currency}, #{rateDate}, #{rate}, #{source}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (CURRENCY, RATE_DATE) DO UPDATE SET RATE = EXCLUDED.RATE, SOURCE = EXCLUDED.SOURCE, FETCHED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
